newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium to issue bonds in Euro as of 1999.
newsitem.headline: Belgium to issue bonds in Euro as of 1999.

text.p: The Belgian state will start issuing linear bonds and Treasury bill certificates in Euros as of January 1, 1999, Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said on Wednesday.

Maystadt, in a speech to the Belgian Banking Association's annual meeting, also said that the entire amount of linear bonds outstanding at that moment would be immediately converted from Belgian francs into Euro.
He said the Belgian Treasury would start talks with the 15 primary dealers of state debt about what to do with the T-bills outstanding.
